itinerary.title: Tarangire National Park- Game Drive
itinerary.description: Pick up from the hotel in Arusha after your breakfast at 9:00 AM and start your journey to Tarangire National Park. The journey is about 3 hours to the main entrance gate. You will arrive at Tarangire and do registration at the gate for 15-20 minutes, and then you will proceed with the morning game drive to Baobab Tented Camp inside Tarangire National Park & check-in. You will have your lunch at the lodge, and after lunch you will proceed with an afternoon game drive for about 3-4 hours, and here you will have an opportunity to see elephants, lions, wildebeests, zebras, buffalo, impalas, gazelles, hartebeests, eland, and many other animals crowding to the Tarangire River and different kinds of birds flocking around the river stream. Later in the evening, you will drive to Karatu for overnight at Eileens Trees Inn (full board).

itinerary.title: Lake Manyara National Park Game Drive and Mto wa Mbu Village tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast at Baobab Tented Camp, you will start your day at Lake Manyara National Park, which is about 2 hours’ drive from Tarangire National Park. You will check in about 15 minutes, then proceed with the game drive for 3 hours. Lake Manyara National Park will provide you with a unique wilderness experience, including diverse landscapes such as the Rift Valley soda lake, open grasslands, dense woodlands, stunning mountainsides, and abundant wildlife. You will have an opportunity to spot greater and lesser pink flamingos on Lake Manyara shores. Around noon, you will have your picnic lunch at the picnic site. After lunch, you will proceed to Mto wa Mbu, a village adjacent to the park. Your guide will be from the village itself, so you will have a unique opportunity to see the community through his eyes. After your tour, you will proceed to Karatu Town for about 30 minutes. Dinner and overnight at Eileens Trees Inn (swimming pool and Wi-Fi available free) (full board).

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater-Game Drive
itinerary.description: After breakfast at 08:00am, we will start our journey to Ngorongoro and descend in a 600-meter deep, 20-kilometer-wide, and 300-square-kilometer caldera, which is a breathtaking experience for the game drive. This magnificent crater is one of the most densely populated African wildlife areas in the world and is home to an estimated 30,000 animals, including some of Tanzania’s last remaining Black Rhino. Supported by a year-round water supply and fodder, the Ngorongoro crater supports a vast variety of animals, which include herds of Wildebeest, Zebra, Buffalo, Eland, Warthog, Hippo, and giant African Elephants. Another uniqueness of the crater is its huge population of predators, which include lions, hyenas, jackals, cheetahs, and the ever-elusive leopard. In the afternoon, you will enjoy your picnic lunch at the Hippo pool. Later, you will continue with the afternoon game drive for 2-3 hours, then after you will ascend to the top of the crater and enjoy the view of the crater from your lodge.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro to Serengeti National Park-Game Drive
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will proceed to Serengeti for about 4 hours from Ngorongoro with an on-rote game drive. After about 3 hours, you will arrive at the Serengeti Naabi entrance gate and have your picnic lunch. The Serengeti National Park is the jewel in the crown of Tanzania’s game parks and offers arguably the best game viewing in Africa. The setting is perfect—a sea of endless plains that stretches to the horizon, dotted with the occasional acacia tree and termite mound. This Savannah is home to huge herds of buffalo that every year make the mass migration north during August/September, through crocodile-infested rivers, in a frenzied mixture of mating and galloping that is driven by instinct. Prides of lions rule here, their hungry gaze sweeping the Savannah for a chance to attack the thousands of elands, impalas, and gazelles. Solitary leopards stake out their place in the high branches of the acacia tree, and herds of elephant’s roam at will.

itinerary.title: Serengeti National Park-Game Drive (Migration)
itinerary.description: Another beautiful day in Serengeti National Parkpark. Today you will have a full day to explore Serengeti National Park. You will wake up early in the morning at 6:00am for an early 1-2 hour sunrise game drive with your breakfast box. Later, you will have your picnic breakfast at 8:00am. You can as well go back to your lodge if you prefer having your breakfast there. If you like to watch wildlife from another perspective, we recommend you go on a 45-minute hot air balloon safari (this is an optional activity available on request for $550 per person). It is an amazing experience to drift silently above the plains with herds of wildlife. If the migration will be closer, your driver guide will drive for about 2 hours northwards in central Serengeti, explore the migration for 2 hours, have a picnic lunch, and later return to your lodge for dinner and overnight at Narudi Tented Camp.

itinerary.title: Serengeti to Karatu Via Ngorongoro
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will do the final third-day on-route game in Serengeti during the morning hours for 2 hours while driving to the Southern Serengeti. Our professional guide will insure you enjoy the wild by taking you to the spotting areas. Later afternoon, you will break at Naani Gate, have your picnic lunch, and continue with the end-route afternoon game drive. You will leave Serengeti Naabi Gate in the afternoon and drive for 2 hours to the top of Ngorongoro crater, then proceed for 1 hour to Karatu Town. Dinner and overnight at Eileens Trees Inn, there is swimming opportunity and free Wi-Fi (Full Board).

itinerary.title: Karatu to Lake Eyasi (Hadzabe and Datoga Bushmen Tour)
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you and our driver will start a journey to Lake Eyasi for 2 hours, which is a mildly alkaline lake about 50 km in length. The meadows along the shores of the lake are home to leopards, hippos, various monkeys, and birds. On arrival, you will do cultural visits in the area. Among other places, you will visit the Datoga pastoralists and members of the Hadzabe tribe. The Hadzabe are one of two remaining hunter-gatherer tribes in Tanzania. There are approximately 1500 families left in this tribe. Lake Eyasi offers excellent views of the Rift Valley escarpment and is an ideal destination for relaxing and bird-watching. After activities, you will have your lunch, and later in the afternoon, drive for 2 hours to Karatu and arrive before 5pm. Dinner and overnight at Eileens Trees Inn, there is swimming opportunity and free Wi-Fi (Full Board).

itinerary.title: Karatu to Arusha
itinerary.description: You will check out late around 11 or 12 and have your early lunch at 12 or 1pm. On the way, you will stop at Maasai Boma and experience Maasai culture, including dancing. Then proceed to Arusha for 2.5 hours, then overnight at the Mount Meru Hotel in Arusha (bed and breakfast).

itinerary.title: Arusha National Park Game Drive and Walking Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will drive about 1 hour to Arusha National Park. The park is beautiful and famous for its green surroundings, lakes, unique sights, and its black and white colubus monkey. About a 2-hour walking safari is a unique and thrilling experience and a chance to be up-close with wild animals, face-to-face. Here you’ll be walking alongside wild, freely roaming animals in their natural habitat. Your park ranger is experienced and knows what you can or can’t do near wild animals. During the walking safari, some unique sights will be visited, like the impressive Meru waterfall that hides in the heart of the park, the Ngurdoto Crater, and Lake Momella, where thousands of pink flamingos can often be spotted. You will have your lunch at Momela Lake Picnic Site. Later, you will travel to Moshi for 1.5 hours for an overnight at Kibo Palace Hotel in Moshi (bed and breakfast).

itinerary.title: Materuni Waterfalls and Coffee Tour in Moshi & Chemka Hot spring
itinerary.description: After breakfast, at 8:00 am, you will leave the hotel for Materuni Waterfalls and Coffee Tour for 45 minutes. It is the highest and most impressive waterfall at the foothills of Mt. Kilimanjaro. You’ll visit a coffee farm and learn about how coffee is grown, harvested, and processed, and you’ll try your hand at roasting and preparing a fresh cup of coffee the Chagga way for 1 hour. After the coffee tour and taste, you’ll take a beautiful 30-minute hike through the hills and valleys en route to the Materuni waterfalls. The valleys and hills are covered by tropical rainforest, coffee, banana, and avocado "shambas," the Kiswahili word for farms. On a clear day, a great view of Kibo and Moshi town can be seen while hiking. The hike to the base of the waterfall can be demanding, and hiking boots are recommended. At 11 am, we will proceed to Chemka Hot Springs for 2 hours and arrive around 1:00 pm. Then at 4:00 pm, you will travel to the airport revitalized and relaxed after your amazing African safari.

itinerary.title: 3: Nyerere National Park- Guided Game drive (Full day)
itinerary.description: You will be picked up from your hotel in Dar es Salaam in the morning around 06:00 am drive to Nyerere National Park the park is located in South Eastern Tanzania, roughly 230 kilometers, four hours’ drive by road from Dar es Salaam city to Mtemere Gate. The park was carved out from the Selous Game reserve, a huge wilderness area and safari destination in Southern Tanzania. Nyerere Park boasts of the largest concentration of wild animals and a rich collection of wildlife that is abundant and diverse. Good numbers of Big Cats such as Lion, Leopard, and Cheetah are to be found here along with other large Game animals such as Elephant, Rhino, Buffalo, Giraffe, Eland, Zebra, Wildebeest and other wildlife. Upon your arrival, our guide will finish all formalities then you will proceed with game drive till afternoon then lunch and camp check inn.  Later you will leave for an evening guided boat ride at Rufiji River. Return to the camp for dinner and overnight stay at Nyerere Beho Beho Camp (Full Board).

itinerary.title: Nyerere National Park to Mikumi National Park
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will check out in the camp and continue to morning drive spotting animals while heading to exit gate and start drive to Mikumi National Park 230 kilometers, taking about 5-6 hours’ drive. The park is endowed with spectacular concentration of wildlife which are rarely seen in other parks like magnificent Sable antelope, African hunting dog, blue wildebeest, Lichtenstein’s hartebeest and others. The gentle foothills and vast Miombo woodland savanna in the southern parts of the park are quite spectacular. Whilst on safari, you will see a wide variety of bird species, zebras, hippos, hartebeests, wildebeests, impalas, warthogs, elands, antelopes, giraffes, buffalo and elephants. If you are lucky, you may also be able to spot lions, leopards and African wild dogs. Several observation towers enable you to overview the park in its entirety. Enjoy a picnic lunch during the day, dinner and your overnight at Tan swiss Lodge (Full Board).

itinerary.title: Mikumi National Park- Guided Game Drive (Full day)
itinerary.description: Today you will continue to explore Mikumi national park with full guided game drive. Mikumi is one of the most popular National Park in Tanzania the park is also decorated by its superbly scenic plains and baobabs and it is home to various wild animals and birds’ species. If you are interested in wildlife and nature, Mikumi is definitely worth visiting. The park offers a unique safari experience, as it is less crowded than some of the more well-known national parks in Tanzania, such as Serengeti or Ngorongoro. This is another beautiful day for you to spot many animals in the park including cats group, elephants, rhinos, giraffes and many more. In the afternoon you will enjoy your packed lunch at the picnic site them continue with the game till evening where you will drive heading to your accommodation center for dinner and overnight stay (Full board).

itinerary.title: Mikumi to Udzungwa Mountains National Park
itinerary.description: You will wake up in the morning to have breakfast then check out to your accommodation as well as park authorities and start journey of 2-3 hours 149 km drive to Udzungwa Mountains National Park established in 1992 and covers an area of 1990km2 where geographically, 20% of the total area lies in Morogoro region while the remaining 80% being in the southern highland region of Iringa. The wildlife spotted in the park includes elephants, leopards, bush bucks, duikers, palm civets, Miombo genets, elephant shrews and hyenas and primates group. Among the primates Iringa red colobus and the Sanje crested Mangabey are the unique ones. With more than 400 species of birds species. Upon your arrival the guide will finish all formalities and enjoying the lunch then you will start your guided game drive till evening where you will drive heading to your accommodation center for dinner and overnight stay (Full board).

itinerary.title: Udzungwa Mountains National Park to Ruaha National Park
itinerary.description: You will wake up in the morning to have breakfast and pack your lunch. We will check out of the lodge and start the final game drive and visit Sanje waterfalls as an optional activity and enjoy the lunch there. After all, in the Udzungwa National Park, you will start another journey of 4 hours’ drive, 231 km to Ruaha National Park found in the Iringa region. Upon your arrival, you will enjoy the beautiful scenery of the Iringa environment. Dinner and an overnight stay will be at the Mount Royal Villa Hotel outside of Ruaha National Park (bed and breakfast).

itinerary.title: Ruaha National Park
itinerary.description: Ruaha National Park is a national park in Tanzania where by in 2008, the Usangu Game Reserve and other important wetlands were added to the park, increasing its size to about 20,226 km2 (7,809 sq mi) .The Park is about 130 kilometers (81 mi) west of Iringa.  After breakfast in the morning with packed lunches, you will drive to the park 15 minutes for full-day game drives. Upon arrival your guide will do all formalities to get entry permits then proceed with game drive spotting different animals like kudus, wildebeests, elephants, zebras, lions, hippos, hartebeests, impalas, antelopes, giraffes, and buffalo. In the afternoon you will drive to the picnic site for lunch then continue with game drive till evening, where you will drive to your accommodation center inside of national park for check inn, dinner and your overnight stay at Ikaka Safari Camp (Full board).

itinerary.title: Ruaha National Park to Mafia Island
itinerary.description: You will wake up in the morning around 08:00 am to have breakfast followed by checking out in the accommodation place. We will start final game drive heading to exit gate to sign out. You will drive to the souvenir shop at town for you to purchase some gifts of your interest and enjoy you lunch at the restaurant in town center while saying good bye to your safari driver guide. At the evening you will be transferred to Iringa airport to take flight to Mafia Island. Up on your arrival our company representative will pick you up to your hotel for dinner and overnight stay at Kinasi Lodge (Bed and breakfast)

itinerary.title: 13: Mafia Island beach extension
itinerary.description: Discover the paradise of Mafia Island, the hidden gem of Tanzania, where nature is still untouched and life is peaceful. The island is 50 kilometers long and 15 kilometers wide. The protected marine park surrounding Mafia Island offers an environment rich in whales and other marine mammals. Access to the island is limited to visitors, making it quieter than the main island of Zanzibar. Mafia Island is a true paradise for those seeking both adventure and tranquility. Whether diving into the vibrant coral reefs, exploring historical ruins, or simply relaxing on pristine beaches, there’s something for everyone. Our guide will lead you in every single activity to make sure you will enjoy the best of being in such wonderful hidden island. Dinner and overnight stay will be provided at Kinasi Lodge (Full board).

itinerary.title: Mafia Island to Dar es Salaam
itinerary.description: Enjoy a leisurely breakfast and some final moments on the beach before preparing for your departure. Depending on your flight schedule, you may have time for a last swim or stroll before transferring back to Dar es Salaam for your onward journey.

title: 9-Days Tanzania Southern Safari and Zanzibar Beach Tour
overview:
Embark to the unforgettable Tanzania safari and beach extension! Explore the fantastic Mikumi national park home to various animals. Immerse to Nyerere National Park (Selous game reserve) known as animal paradise where you will witness different animals on actions like lion on hunting activity. Lastly you will finish with stunning trip to Zanzibar where you will explore the Nakupenda beach, Prison Island, Mnemba atoll and spice form and get directly contact with local people. This tour operated yearly but highly recommended during the dry season in Tanzania because of easier to spot many animals. Also, this tour rated in easy level that favor children, adults, pregnant and others. Don’t plan to miss this unforgettable experience.

Highlights of the tour

  • Mikumi National Park
  • Nyerere National Park
  • Nakupenda beach extension
  • Mnemba snorkeling
  • Prison island beach tour
  • Spice tour
  • Guided game drive
  • Big five wildlife view

itinerary.title: Arrival in Tanzania and transfer to the hotel
itinerary.description: On your arrival at Dar es salaam International Airport a member of our staff will be holding a placard of KLM Safaris. After welcome note, you will then be transferred to Coral Beach Hotel in Dar es Salaam. In the evening our safari guide will be there to give you a briefing information about you tour so that you can understand what to pack, what to bring, where to use, and not. (Bed and Breakfast).

itinerary.title: Nyerere National Park- Guided Game drive (Full day)
itinerary.description: You will be picked up from your hotel in Dar es Salaam in the morning around 06:00 am and drive to Nyerere National Park the park is located in south Eastern Tanzania, roughly 230 kilometers by road from Dar es Salaam city to Mtemere Gate, and was carved out from the Selous Game reserve, a huge wilderness area and safari destination in Southern Tanzania. Nyerere Park boasts of the largest concentration of wild animals and a rich collection of wildlife that is abundant and diverse. Good numbers of Big Cats such as Lion, Leopard, and Cheetah are to be found here along with other large Game animals such as Elephant, Rhino, Buffalo, Giraffe, Eland, Zebra, Wildebeest and other wildlife. Upon your arrival, our guide will finish all formalities then you will proceed with game drive till afternoon heading for lunch and camp check inn. Then leave for an evening boat drive at Rufiji River. Return to the camp for dinner and your overnight stay are at Nyerere Tented Camp.

itinerary.title: Nyerere National Park to Mikumi National Park
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, you will check out in the camp and continue to morning drive spotting animals while heading to exit gate and start drive to Mikumi National Park 230 kilometers, taking about 5-6 hours to drive. The park is endowed with spectacular concentration of wildlife which are rarely seen in other parks like
 
 
 
Magnificent Sable antelope, African hunting dog, blue wildebeest, Lichtenstein’s hartebeest and others. The gentle foothills and vast Miombo woodland savanna in the southern parts of the park are quite spectacular. Whilst on safari, you will see a wide variety of bird species, zebras, hippos, hartebeests, wildebeests, impalas, warthogs, elands, antelopes, giraffes, buffalo and elephants. If you are lucky, you may also be able to spot lions, leopards and African wild dogs. Several observation towers enable you to overview the park in its entirety. Enjoy a picnic lunch during the day and dinner and your overnight stay are at your accommodation center.

itinerary.title: Mikumi National Park- Guided Game drive (Full day)
itinerary.description: Today you have a full day to explore Mikumi National Park with a full guided game drive. This is another beautiful day for you to spot many animals in the park, including a group of cats, elephants, rhinos, giraffes, and many more. Mikumi national park is transected by surfaced road between Dar es salaam and Iringa It is the most accessible park and the fourth largest park in Tanzania. More than 400 bird species have been recorded, with such colorful common residents as the lilac-breasted roller, yellow-shrouded long-claw hippos as the main attraction of their pair of pools situated 5 km north of the main entrance gate. Most visitors come to Mikumi National Park aiming to spot the ‘Big Five’ (cheetah, lion, elephant, buffalo, and rhino), and they are always not disappointed. Hippo pools provide close access to the mud-loving beasts, and bird-watching along the waterways is particularly rewarding. Mikumi National Park borders the Nyerere national park and Udzungwa National Park, and the three locations make a varied and pleasant safari circuit. In the afternoon you will head to the picnic site for your packed lunch and then continue with the game drive till evening, where you will drive to your accommodation center for dinner and an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Mikumi National park to Dar es Salaam to Zanzibar
itinerary.description: Today you will wake up around 08:00 am to have your breakfast and then prepare your staff. You will check out at your accommodation center and then start the final short game drive toward the exit gate, where your guide will sign you out, and then start the drive of 184 km, which takes 4-5 hours. On the way, we will stop at the restaurant for your lunch then you will continue to Dar es Salaam where you will take flight to Zanzibar, and our guide will pick you and transfer to the hotel hence dinner and overnight stay will be provided at Zanzibar Royal Zanzibar Beach Resort

itinerary.title: Prison Island Beach Tour
itinerary.description: After having your breakfast in the morning, the guide will pick you up and transfer you to Prison Island, a small, picturesque island located about 5.6 kilometers (3.5 miles) northwest of Stone Town, Zanzibar. This coral island is a popular tourist destination, known for its intriguing history, stunning beaches, and its sanctuary of giant Aldabra tortoises. You will have an opportunity to explore the rich culture and history of Zanzibar with a visit to Prison Island by boat. See the large tortoises that inhabit the island and enjoy the opportunity to snorkel off the coast.

itinerary.title: Nakupenda Beach Tour
itinerary.description: Nakupenda Beach offers visitors a slice of paradise, with stunning white sands, crystal-clear turquoise waters, and a tranquil, tropical ambiance. Nakupenda, meaning "I love you" in Swahili, is a pristine sandbank located just off the coast of Stone Town. Accessible only by boat, the sandbank appears and disappears with the tides, creating a unique, ephemeral setting ideal for a day trip filled with relaxation, swimming, and marine exploration. In the evening you will return to your hotel for dinner and an overnight stay at Zanzibar Serena Hotel.

itinerary.title: Mnemba Snorkeling
itinerary.description: Mnemba Atoll, located off the northeastern coast of Zanzibar, Tanzania, is renowned for its stunning snorkeling experiences. This small, private island is surrounded by crystal-clear waters and vibrant coral reefs, making it a popular destination for snorkelers and divers alike. The waters around Mnemba Atoll are teeming with marine life. Snorkelers can expect to see a variety of colorful fish, including parrotfish, clownfish, and angelfish, as well as sea turtles, dolphins, and even the occasional reef shark. In the morning after breakfast, your guide will pick you up, heading to Mnemba Atoll, where you will spend the day diving and snorkeling in that beautiful atoll. At noon the lunch will be provided, where you will enjoy the most stunning seafood and fresh fruits or juice. Later in the evening you will jump in the boat heading to your accommodation center for dinner and an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Spice tour and Departure
itinerary.description: After having your breakfast, your guide will pick you up to start a tour heading to the spice farm. A spice farm tour in Zanzibar is a unique, immersive experience that delves into the island’s rich history as a spice hub and offers a sensory exploration of its agricultural treasures. Known as the "Spice Island," Zanzibar has a tropical climate ideal for cultivating a variety of spices such as cloves, cinnamon, black pepper, cardamom, nutmeg, and vanilla. These spices, which once drove Zanzibar’s economy and established its historical significance on the trade routes, remain an integral part of the island’s identity and local culture. Later, after finishing the spice tour, you have a chance to visit different souvenir shops, and your guide will drop you off at the airport. End of the tour
